generation.scope: For any point-fiber window, a cubic slice with all three supports of dimension three produces a ternary subalgebra over which the window is left and right free. Regularity is equivalent to rank-one avoidance in its three ternary nets. For all finite four-edge Frobenius candidates the quadratic relation spaces automatically avoid rank one, by length-ten planar residuals. Consequently opposite rank below six is empty and every finite candidate of opposite rank six or seven is standard AS, with previously finite indexed isomorphism and period tests.

open_mathematics: For remaining finite graphs all cubic slices have middle support four unless already certified. Examine their three-by-three determinant cubics on the opposite twenty-point scheme, scheme-theoretic four-step periodicity, and resulting regularity or rank constraints.
